# reference/src Repo Map

Generated from a full recursive traversal of `reference/src`, with source files scanned for direct `#include` imports and leading comment summaries. Binary and project artifacts are summarized from filename and extension.

## Reading Guide

- `KB` is file size rounded from bytes.
- `Imports` lists direct local/system includes for text source files; build artifacts usually show `—`.
- `Semantic summary` is heuristic, using leading comments when they are informative and filename/folder patterns when they are not.

## Best Reference Files

- [`README.md`](README.md) - Curated overview of the tree and the fastest route into the filesystem/archive/serialization stack.
- [`ALIEN_CODE.md`](ALIEN_CODE.md) - Curated shortlist of the weird, high-leverage systems worth borrowing.
- [`file/device.h`](file/device.h) - Core filesystem device abstraction and mount routing.
- [`file/stream.h`](file/stream.h) - Buffered stream wrapper and typed I/O layer.
- [`file/asset.h`](file/asset.h) - Logical asset-path resolution.
- [`file/packfile.h`](file/packfile.h) - RPF7 archive device.
- [`data/serialize.h`](data/serialize.h) - Generic serialization interface.
- [`data/resource.h`](data/resource.h) - Resource relocation and fixup.
- [`xmldata/data.cpp`](xmldata/data.cpp) - Schema-driven XML load/save implementation.
- [`xmldata/datatypes.cpp`](xmldata/datatypes.cpp) - Typed XML field implementations.
- [`net/task2.h`](net/task2.h) - Lambda-based async task graph.
- [`system/task.h`](system/task.h) - Legacy scheduler and worker runtime.
- [`system/threadpool.h`](system/threadpool.h) - Worker-thread pool.
- [`system/virtualallocator.h`](system/virtualallocator.h) - Virtual/physical allocator split.
- [`vectormath/README.txt`](vectormath/README.txt) - SIMD/SoA vector-math rewrite overview.
- [`audioengine/ambisonics.h`](audioengine/ambisonics.h) - Ambisonic decoding and coefficient optimization.
- [`audiohardware/granularsubmix.cpp`](audiohardware/granularsubmix.cpp) - Granular audio synthesis and submix pipeline.
- [`audiohardware/waveslot.cpp`](audiohardware/waveslot.cpp) - Async wave-slot loading and caching.
- [`zlib/inflateServer.cpp`](zlib/inflateServer.cpp) - Service-style decompression worker.
